title: Construct affine centre access and prove literal Haar limits
body:
This construction gives exact access to one maximum-dimension affine part of the sufficient all-odd phase sector at every positive tensor width. A signed Haar code implements a projector shear on two arbitrary physical fields, restores the source, and retains every complement. A combined projected quarter turn uses one encode and one decode per field. Under the pinned stream and completed-frame assumptions, both add no complex native child or owner family.

The [proof map](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa/research/affine-centre-access/PROOF.md), [independent publication review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa/research/publication-reviews/affine-centre-access/REVIEW.md), and [source manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa/research/affine-centre-access/SOURCES.json) give the exact claims and dependencies. **This does not improve the complete kappa calculation.** Actual owner-cut binding, a complete finite invoice, and recursive supplier admission remain open.

For `n>=2` rows and tensor width `lambda`, the sharp affine dimension is `n floor(lambda/2)+(lambda mod 2)`. The equality classification requires `n>=3`. A separate scoped negative result proves `Omega(lambda V)` forward split work for a complete all-odd-sector projector implemented by literal affine Haar trees with complete fixed-format records. It permits branch-dependent affine tests and charts. It does not cover general linear circuits, non-affine blocks, overlap cancellation, productive native children, or a query that does not form the projector.

The local stream bound is `O(V((e log p)^tau+1))`, with fixed `n`, `e=n lambda`, and `0<tau<1`. It includes paid address maps and full guarded records. The exact-grid bounds reserve the stated fractional and magnitude bits before the layer; no internal rounding or clean borrowed-signal premise is used. Internal recursive use still requires a valid dependency-path envelope for the changed controller.

The publication base is `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. Its [selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51/certificates/selected-result.json) identifies [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470), with conditional kappa `0.00302015`. This package does not change that record or prove transfer to that construction. It retains the historical stream source at `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; the [source notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f/NOTICE) credits @icekylinx for the bulk recursion, compact tensor basis, and dependency-path guard, and retains the OpenAI manuscript and earlier contributor notices. The [package notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa/research/affine-centre-access/NOTICE.md) separates those consumed premises from the new local proofs and checks. Source licenses remain intact. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; no independent human review is claimed.

Use Python 3.10 or later and the standard library. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/affine-centre-access/verify.py --output /tmp/affine-centre-access-replay
```

The output directory must not exist. The expected final line is:

```text
PASS_AFFINE_CENTRE_ACCESS
```

The fresh independent replay ran from a relocated package and passed all eight checks. Seven receipts matched the frozen receipts byte for byte; the density adapter reproduced its four general mathematical result groups. All 55 campaign evidence files and eight upstream source, license, and notice files matched their originals or pinned Git objects. See the [validation record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa/research/affine-centre-access/VALIDATION.md) and [independent replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa/research/publication-reviews/affine-centre-access/REPLAY.json).

The stream checks reject omitted Haar details, a wrong leaf-update sign, and an incorrect one-column phase. The odd-width check rejects the wrong final-coordinate sign in all three cases.

The density replay deliberately excludes actual 17-axis route maximality. The one-pass-turn and product-cover executables are producer checks with separate written proof reviews. No fixed-tape machine execution, actual owner schedule, complete supplier replay, recursive admission, or selected kappa calculation was run. [Open next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4c42b1925ca589ca5a773f3e791d90b28dd79dfa/research/affine-centre-access/README.md#open-next-questions) state the remaining obligations.
